nonblocking_notes: This amended acceptance applies only to future attempts using this exact amended packet. Original first R16 integrity failure and its bound revise review remain; it is not a negative H1. Original reviews are preserved and do not authorize mutable amended inputs.

Quarantine removes4release questionIDs/2whole clusters, not a fixed target outcome. All excluded groups happen to fall in the pre-existing confirmation split. This is known before ACK aggregation; no claim about excluded population is allowed. Metadata has been inspected across reserve, so only unqueried generated-model outcomes retain statistical reserve status.

Acceptance is readiness for a bounded descriptive audit. It does not establish empirical sensitivity, robustness, novelty, journal readiness or alignment safety. Actual metadata could fail; preserve failure and do not relax definitions after outcomes.

Question aliases share bootstrap multiplicity while point weights remain equal released core IDs. Counts of raw rows, generations and aliases are not independent sample sizes. Resampling approximates question variation conditional on cached generations and source judge labels; it does not capture annotator or new-model-generation uncertainty.

Exact released-input equality may omit system/provider prompts. Common-input support restriction changes population and can select on model-dependent baseline answers. Composition/version decomposition is descriptive, not causal correction or proof original adaptive estimand is wrong.

Novelty is limited by existing Meek adaptive-cue/state-transition work and OpenAI beyond-gmean-squared matching/behavior-class limitations. Standard matching, maxT, baseline-correctness algebra and decompositions are not new methods. A meaningful scientific contribution depends on heldout empirical evidence and honest practical implications.

No reserve outcome analysis is authorized. A next hypothesis needs a separately frozen preregistration and independent review before one use of reserve. Multiple attempted hypotheses must be disclosed; per-study nominal familywise intervals do not imply program-wide95percent validity.

R17 common method description refers to frozen R16PLAN; both PLANs/protocols and both machine plans are hashbound here. R16 closure and original snapshot must remain verified/restorable as dependency evidence.
